Where to stay in Athens

Every area rated for day and night, with the reasoning and the sources behind each rating.

🟡 Local-source safety assessment · 7 areas reviewed individually Methodology →

For a short stay in Athens: 1st Municipal District (Syntagma, Plaka, Monastiraki, Omonoia, Kolonaki, Exarchia), 2nd Municipal District (Pangrati, Mets, Neos Kosmos) and 3rd Municipal District (Thiseio, Petralona, Votanikos). One area for each kind of trip, each shown with its own day and night rating — including where that rating says be careful. None of them is here because someone paid for it.

Calm — no particular concern
Caution — fine by day, be more careful in the evening/night
Not recommended for a tourist — known, recurring issues
